rule: Primary metric: QMDP average accuracy over 0-2400 s, 200 starting labels, training annotators, tuning seeds 100-109, averaged with equal weight over None, Markov beta=1, Markov beta=2 and FALCON beta=1. Lapse is reported but not used. Step 1: for each lambda, the paired difference to the best lambda (per seed, averaged over the four worlds) gets a bootstrap 95% interval (4,000 resamples, seed 42). Step 2: candidates are all lambdas whose interval reaches 0 (not clearly worse than the best). Step 3: among candidates, choose the one closest to the Stage-1 theory value (median Dinkelbach fixed point over the four worlds); ties go to the smaller lambda. The same lambda is then used by every lambda-aware policy.
